title: Vision Plans Early-Cancellation Benefit Offset on Premium Billing Accounts Termination Credits
content:
**Rule.** An early-cancellation benefit offset is deducted from the termination credit of a vision plan unit on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement when the unit ended before its second coverage anniversary and the vision benefits paid outran the premium, as set out below. The offset is taken from the product of the amount per month and the months counted, before anything is added, and that remainder never falls below 0.00.

**Terms**
- *The unit's coverage months* — the whole calendar months from the unit's coverage effective date to its termination date, plus one.
- *The unit* — the plan unit of the subscriber's Vision Plans enrollment funded by the account that shows a voluntary termination: every vision enrollment of the subscriber funded by the account, the subscriber's own and each enrollee's, which share that enrollment's plan, coverage tier and dates (where more than one such subscriber enrollment is on record, the one with the latest termination date, and of two with the same termination date the one recorded first).
- *Vision benefits paid* — the plan payments on the vision services of the unit, that is of every enrollment in it, remarked as paid in network or as reimbursed out of network, less the plan payments carried by reversals of those services. The services are read from all of the subscriber's Vision Plans claims, so the benefits paid are counted only when no vision enrollment of the subscriber, other than one whose status is cancelled (an application withdrawn before its start, an application cancelled for an unpaid binder, or a plan returned in the free-look period), has ever been funded by another billing account; otherwise no offset is deducted.
- *Coverage window* — a service lies within the unit's coverage window when the whole calendar months from its date of service to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the unit's coverage effective date to the credit date, and no fewer than the whole calendar months from the unit's termination date to the credit date.
- *Within twelve months* — a service is dated within twelve months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its date of service to the credit date are fewer than 12.
- Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted: a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it.
- *Filed monthly premium* — the monthly premium of the unit's Vision Plans plan for its coverage tier.

**Tiers**
| Unit's coverage months | Benefits test | Offset |
|---|---|---|
| at least 1 and no more than 12 | vision benefits paid on services within the coverage window exceed the filed monthly premium multiplied by the coverage months | that excess |
| more than 12 and no more than 24 | vision benefits paid on services within the coverage window and dated within twelve months before the credit date exceed twelve times the filed monthly premium | that excess |
| any other case (including a test not met, or a non-cancelled vision enrollment of the subscriber ever funded by another billing account) | — | no offset |

**Boundary points.** A unit with 12 coverage months is measured on the first row; one with 13 on the second; one with 24 on the second; one with 25 has no offset.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- Coverage effective 1 June, termination 31 March of the next year: 9 complete months plus one, 10 coverage months. Filed premium 13.25, so 132.50 over the coverage months. Benefits within the window of 180.00 give an offset of 47.50; benefits of 120.00 give none.
- Coverage months 18, filed premium 13.25 (twelve times: 159.00). Window benefits dated within twelve months before the credit date of 171.30 give an offset of 12.30; benefits earlier in the window do not enter this test.
- As the first illustration, with the subscriber's own enrollment carrying 45.00 of out-of-network reimbursements and two enrollees' enrollments in the same plan unit carrying 70.00 each: benefits paid are 185.00, offset 52.50. Had the subscriber once held a vision enrollment funded by another billing account that was active rather than cancelled, no offset would be deducted.
